THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Lazy But Getting Jacked Thanksgiving

Thanksgiving for four means I can keep it simple: warm up Hormel sliced turkey breast and gravy, serve it with cottage-cheese mash, and air-fry the potato peels for a buttery crunch.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME25 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~413 cal | ~39g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Peel and weigh 700g raw gold potatoes, boil until fork-tender, and mash with 150g Good Culture 2% cottage cheese blended smooth with 1/4 cup Nurri whole protein milk plus 1 tbsp Kernel Season’s Butter Popcorn Seasoning (makes 4 servings).

Ingredients

Shared

  • Hormel Square Table Sliced Roasted Turkey Breast & Gravy
  • Protein Mashed Popcorn batch (700g peeled raw potatoes + 150g Good Culture 2% cottage cheese + 1/4 cup Nurri whole protein milk + 1 tbsp butter popcorn seasoning)
  • Crispy Potato Skins batch (100g potato peels + 1 tbsp olive oil + 1 tsp butter popcorn seasoning)

Kid Plate — Bite-Sized Hormel Turkey & Gravy + Protein Mashed Popcorn

  • Kid-sized portion of Hormel Square Table sliced turkey breast and gravy, cut into bite-sized pieces

Adult Plate — 1.5 Servings Hormel Turkey & Gravy + 1/4 Batch Mash + 1/3 Batch Crispy Skins (≈413 cal / 39g P)

  • 1 1/2 label servings (210g) Hormel Square Table sliced turkey breast and gravy (165 cal / 28.5g P)
  • 1/3 batch Crispy Potato Skins (66 cal / 0.9g P)
  • Optional: extra gravy on mash (separate from base macro estimate)

You want a Thanksgiving-style turkey-and-mashed-potatoes dinner for four without roasting a whole bird—landing at ≈413 calories, 39g protein, 38g carbs, and 10g fat per adult plate.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.Boil the 700g peeled potatoes until fork-tender, then fold with the smooth blended cottage cheese, Nurri protein milk, and 1 tbsp butter popcorn seasoning.
  2. 2.Air-fry the 100g dried, oiled, and seasoned potato peels at 325°F for 15–20 minutes while warming the sliced turkey breast and gravy in a skillet.

Adult Plate — 1.5 Servings Hormel Turkey & Gravy + 1/4 Batch Mash + 1/3 Batch Crispy Skins (≈413 cal / 39g P)

  1. 3.Plate 1 1/2 label servings of warmed Hormel sliced turkey breast with its packaged gravy and 1/4 batch of Protein Mashed Popcorn.
  2. 4.Add 1/3 batch of the air-fried Crispy Potato Skins on the side for buttery crunch (≈413 cal, 39g protein, 38g carbs, 10g fat before any separate gravy).

Kid Plate — Bite-Sized Hormel Turkey & Gravy + Protein Mashed Popcorn · Kid Plate — Bite-Sized Hormel Turkey & Gravy + Protein Mashed Popcorn

  1. 3.Cut the warmed sliced turkey breast with gravy into bite-sized pieces on the kid plate and add a scoop of the creamy Protein Mashed Popcorn alongside.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult Plate — 1.5 Servings Hormel Turkey & Gravy + 1/4 Batch Mash + 1/3 Batch Crispy Skins (≈413 cal / 39g P): Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid Plate — Bite-Sized Hormel Turkey & Gravy + Protein Mashed Popcorn: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • Rinse 100g saved potato peels, pat thoroughly dry, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tsp Kernel Season’s Butter Popcorn Seasoning, and air-fry at 325°F for 15–20 minutes until golden and crisp.
  • Warm the Hormel Square Table sliced turkey breast and its packaged gravy in a skillet, then plate 1 1/2 label servings for the adult plate alongside 1/4 batch of the mash and 1/3 batch of the crispy potato skins.

If something fails

Potato skins come out soft instead of crisp: Pat the rinsed peels completely dry between paper towels before tossing with olive oil and butter popcorn seasoning, and spread them out in the air-fryer basket at 325°F for the full 15–20 minutes.

Logging extra gravy on top of the mashed potatoes: The ≈413-calorie, 39g-protein estimate includes the gravy packaged inside the 1 1/2 servings of Hormel turkey breast; add any separate gravy spooned onto the mash to your own count.

Storage and reheating

Store: Store leftover turkey with gravy and leftover Protein Mashed Popcorn in separate airtight containers in the refrigerator for up to 3–4 days. Crisp the potato skins fresh in the air fryer before serving.

Reheat: Warm turkey and mash gently on the stovetop or in the microwave; re-crisp any leftover potato skins in the air fryer at 325°F for 2–3 minutes.

Lasts: Turkey and mash keep 3–4 days refrigerated; crispy skins are best same day.

Estimated nutrition

~413 cal | ~39g protein.

Adult plate estimate with packaged turkey gravy (before any separate gravy or toppings added to the mash): 413 calories, 38.6g protein (rounded to 39g), 38.3g total carbs (rounded to 38g), and 9.9g fat (rounded to 10g). Component breakdown: 1 1/2 label servings Hormel Square Table Sliced Roasted Turkey Breast & Gravy (165 cal, 28.5g protein, 4.5g carbs, 3.75g fat based on 140g label serving = 110 cal / 19g P / 3g C / 2.5g F) + 1/4 batch Protein Mashed Popcorn (182 cal, 9.2g protein, 29.7g carbs, 1.6g fat) + 1/3 batch Crispy Potato Skins (66 cal, 0.9g protein, 4.1g carbs, 4.5g fat from 100g USDA raw potato skin + 1 tbsp olive oil + 1 tsp Kernel Season’s butter popcorn seasoning). Confirmed sides subtotal is 248 cal, 10.1g protein, 33.8g carbs, and 6.1g fat.
